# .luxe/gitkit — generated by `luxe gitkit`

Survey map + the latest gitaudit/gitchange report for this repo, mirrored here so they travel with the code (commit them or not, your call). **Safe to delete or add to `.gitignore`** — the canonical copy lives under `~/.luxe/reports/`. Regenerated on each `luxe gitaudit`/`gitchange` run; skip with `--no-mirror`.
